description: This file defines the StreamFactory class which implements the StreamFactoryInterface from PSR-17, providing methods to create stream objects from strings, files, or resources using GuzzleHttp PSR-7 utilities.

classes.name: StreamFactory
classes.description: A factory class to create PSR-7 StreamInterface objects from strings, files, or resources.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from a string content.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from a file path, opening it with the specified mode.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from an existing resource.
